title: Real-time monitoring of photodegradation in photoresists using a quartz crystal microbalance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12304-12308
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05762G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhun Gu, Kaitong Yang, Hayford Boamah, Dong Chen, Zhiqiang Zhu, Jie Wang
By combining a laser and a QCM sensor, this study presents a convenient method for evaluating the photodegradation of the photoresist AZ1518. Moreover, the contrast, shear force and viscoelasticity values for AZ1518 were obtained.
